text:
```yaml
name: Lint, Style & Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up R
        uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r@v2
        with:
          r-version: '4.3'

      - name: Install R dependencies
        uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r-dependencies@v2
        with:
          packages: |
            lintr
            styler
            testthat
            devtools

      - name: Create .lintr configuration
        run: |
          cat <<'EOF' > .lintr
          lintr::lintr(
            linters = list(
              line_length_linter = lintr::line_length_linter(80),
              indentation_linter = lintr::indentation_linter(width = 2, tab = FALSE)
            )
          )
          EOF

      - name: Run lintr
        run: |
          Rscript -e 'if (length(lintr::lint_package()) > 0) { cat("Lint errors found\n"); quit(status=1) }'

      - name: Run styler
        run: |
          Rscript -e "styler::style_pkg()"

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          Rscript -e 'devtools::load_all(); testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test-huxtable-creation.R")'
```
